lead_raw_text:
This structure has composition Na2Sn and crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1 (No. 1). The unit cell contains three atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: each Na center has 12 geometric neighbors (3 Na, 9 Sn), while Sn centers have 12 Na neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.23 to 3.41 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all three sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Na and Sn coordination polyhedra.
